snippet.title: Pathfinder: The Dragon’s Demand Kickstarter Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Kickstarter campaign for Ossian Studios’ new game, Pathfinder: The Dragon’s Demand, is live.

Partnering with Paizo, makers of the acclaimed Pathfinder tabletop role-playing game, Ossian is developing a video game based on the classic Pathfinder module The Dragon’s Demand by fan-favorite adventure designer Mike Shel. Players will experience the magic of digital miniatures in this vast, single-player, turn-based CRPG that uses the remastered Pathfinder Second Edition rules.

Visit http://www.dragonsdemand.com/ to back the campaign!

Voice-Over Narration: Richard Browning
Music Composer: Will Musser

Website: https://www.ossianstudios.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/OssianStudios
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/OfficialOssianStudios 
X: https://x.com/OssianStudios
